name: Oggleflint
summary: Oggleflint is the chieftain of the trogg tribe dwelling within the volcanic depths of Ragefire Chasm directly beneath Orgrimmar. His troggs have been creeping up from the lava-filled tunnels toward the surface, and from his place near the cavern's entrance he commands a savage pack that poses an immediate threat to the Horde capital above.

sections.title: Chieftain of the Deep
sections.body: Oggleflint and his troggs climbed out of the fiery tunnels deep beneath Orgrimmar and into Ragefire Chasm. Brutal and territorial, they carved out a primitive domain among the molten rock. Though troggs possess little in the way of advanced civilization, Oggleflint maintained absolute authority over the pack through sheer brute strength.

sections.title: Death to Envoys
sections.body: When Elder Crone Magatha Grimtotem sent diplomats into the chasm to make peace with the troggs, the troggs turned on them and killed them. The body of one envoy, Maur Grimtotem, lay in the caverns under Oggleflint's watch. The trogg chieftain now waits near the cavern entrance, striking at any outsider who comes down into the dark.

sections.title: The Threat Beneath Orgrimmar
sections.body: Having troggs directly beneath Thrall's capital is a hazard the Horde cannot tolerate. Creeping closer to the surface, Oggleflint's tribe is far too volatile to leave unchecked, threatening to spill into the Drag and Cleft of Shadow if left undisturbed.

faq.answer: Oggleflint is a powerful trogg chieftain who leads the pack inhabiting Ragefire Chasm beneath the city of Orgrimmar.
He is located in the upper caverns of Ragefire Chasm, not far from the entrance tunnel, where his pack holds the tunnels nearest the surface.

faq.q: Why are the troggs in Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: Troggs naturally dwell deep underground in subterranean volcanic networks. Oggleflint's pack has been coming up from deep below the lava-filled tunnels beneath Orgrimmar toward the surface.

faq.q: Why is Oggleflint hostile to the Horde?
faq.answer: Troggs are fiercely territorial and violent beasts by nature. Pressing up toward the surface, Oggleflint and his followers pose an imminent danger to the Horde tunnels and the city above.

faq.q: What is Oggleflint's relationship with the Searing Blade?
faq.answer: They share the chasm, but nothing makes them allies: Oggleflint's troggs hold the tunnels near the entrance, while the Searing Blade cultists work in the deeper chambers.

angles.text: Living directly beneath Thrall's fortress, Oggleflint's troggs represent a wild, unpredictable security risk right in the heart of Durotar.
For young orcs proving their mettle in the trial of arms, slaying the chieftain lurking right under the Drag is an early test of martial discipline.
Facing Oggleflint means confronting a heavy brute who relies entirely on raw muscle and primal rage rather than armor or discipline.
